blocks.text: Muhammad ﷺ and found them to be like dams. While some dams may quench the thirst of one man, others may quench the thirst of two men, others the thirst of ten and others will quench the thirst of a hundred men. Then there are oceans that can cater for all the people on earth if they had to settle there. I found Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Mas'ood (RA) to be such an ocean." [^1]

Hadhrat Zaid bin Wahab narrates that Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Mas'ood (RA) arrived one day at a place where Hadhrat Umar (RA) was sitting. When he saw Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Mas'ood (RA) approach, Hadhrat Umar (RA) said, "He is a coffer filled to the brim with the knowledge and understanding of Deen."

Hadhrat Asad bin Wadaa'ah reports that Hadhrat Umar (RA) once made mention of Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Mas'ood (RA) saying, "He is a coffer filled to the brim with knowledge. I however had to give preference to the people of Qaadisiyyah over myself concerning him (by sending him to teach them rather than keeping him behind with me in Madinah)." [^2]

The Statement of Hadhrat Ali (RA) concerning his Knowledge and the Knowledge of Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Mas'ood (RA), Hadhrat Abu Moosa Ash'ari (RA), Hadhrat Ammaar (RA), Hadhrat Hudhayfah (RA) and Hadhrat Salmaan (RA)

Hadhrat Abul Bakhtari narrates that they once approached Hadhrat Ali (RA) with the request to inform them about the Sahabah (RA) of Rasulullaah ﷺ. "Which of them would you like to know about?" Hadhrat Ali (RA) asked. "Tell us about Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Mas'ood (RA)," they replied. Hadhrat Ali (RA) said, "He learnt the Qur'aan and the Sunnah and reached the apex of knowledge. This is sufficient for you to gauge the extent of his knowledge." "Tell us about Hadhrat Abu Moosa Ash'ari (RA)," they asked next. Hadhrat Ali (RA) said, "He had been thoroughly dyed in knowledge before coming out of the dye." The men asked further, "Then tell us about Hadhrat Ammaar bin Yaasir (RA)." Hadhrat Ali (RA) said, "He is a Mu'min who remembers well after being reminded about something he had forgotten."
"Now tell us about Hadhrat Hudhayfah (RA)," they asked. Hadhrat Ali (RA)'s reply was: "Of all the Sahabah (RA), he best knew who the Munaafiqeen were." When they asked about Hadhrat Abu Dharr (RA), Hadhrat Ali (RA) said, "He acquired a substantial amount of knowledge but was unable to disseminate it." The men further asked, "Tell us about Hadhrat Salmaan (RA)." Hadhrat Ali (RA) said, "He acquired the knowledge of the previous Ambiyaa as well as the knowledge of the final Nabi ﷺ. He is an ocean whose bottom cannot be reached and he is also one of us, the household of Rasulullaah ﷺ." "O Ameerul Mu'mineen!" the men then asked, "Now tell us about yourself." Hadhrat Ali
